summary: Clarify Story Bible as a local-only draft surface in the near term: five authoring fields stay in localStorage, character/location cards remain graph-backed read data, and any portability work should be explicit local import/export rather than implied project-level persistence.

tasks.title: Make the Story Bible persistence contract explicit in UI, copy, docs, and tests
tasks.description: Codify the current boundary instead of leaving it implicit: mark braindump, genres, synopsis, outline, and style as local-only draft state stored in localStorage; mark characters and locations as graph query results; add visible boundary copy, i18n strings, workflow-doc updates, and a dedicated component test. Do not add gateway or Tauri-backed project persistence in this task.
tasks.scope: Clarify the existing persistence behavior without widening storage scope beyond browser/Tauri WebView local state.

criteria: 1 persistence contract is rendered in the panel and states that 5 draft fields are local-only: [braindump, genres, synopsis, outline, style].
1 documentation update explains that 2 list sections are graph-backed reads: [characters, locations], and are not part of the local draft payload.
1 dedicated desktop component test covers local draft restore/fallback semantics and verifies the boundary copy is visible.
convergence.verification: Run `npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/components/StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx` and `npm --prefix desktop run typecheck`; inspect the updated workflow doc to confirm it names the 5 local-only fields and 2 graph-backed sections explicitly.
convergence.definition_of_done: Users can tell from the panel and docs that Story Bible is currently a local draft aid with graph enrichment, not project-synced persistence, and the behavior is locked by a focused test.

implementation.title: Extract the current persistence contract
implementation.description: List the exact localStorage keys and the graph-backed sections already used by StoryBiblePanel so the execution task works from a concrete contract.

implementation.title: Expose the contract in UI and translations
implementation.description: Add boundary copy and any supporting labels in StoryBiblePanel and translations so the local-only behavior is visible in-product.

implementation.title: Synchronize docs and tests
implementation.description: Update the writing workflow documentation and add StoryBiblePanel test coverage for restore, fallback, and boundary messaging.

tasks.title: Add explicit local backup, restore, and reset for Story Bible drafts
tasks.description: If the boundary remains local-only after E1, add a front-end-only portability flow for the 5 draft fields: export a versioned Story Bible JSON file, import that file back into the panel, and reset the local draft keys. Keep graph-derived character/location data out of the payload so the feature does not masquerade as project persistence.
tasks.scope: Local-only draft portability and recovery for Story Bible; no shared storage, gateway writes, or graph mutation.

criteria: 1 export action writes a versioned payload containing exactly 5 draft fields: [braindump, genres, synopsis, outline, style].
1 import action restores those same 5 fields from a previously exported file and rejects malformed payloads with a visible error state.
1 reset action clears only Story Bible local draft keys and leaves graph-backed character/location loading behavior unchanged.
convergence.verification: Run `npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/components/StoryBiblePanel.test.tsx` and `npm --prefix desktop run typecheck`; then manually export a Story Bible draft, clear/reset it, re-import the file, and confirm the 5 local draft fields restore while character/location cards still come only from graph queries.
convergence.definition_of_done: Story Bible remains honestly local-only, but users now have an explicit backup and recovery path instead of relying on opaque localStorage persistence.

implementation.title: Define the local draft payload
implementation.description: Create a small versioned schema for Story Bible export/import that includes only the 5 local draft fields and excludes graph-derived data.

implementation.title: Implement local-only portability controls
implementation.description: Add export, import, and reset controls in StoryBiblePanel using browser/Tauri WebView file flows rather than gateway APIs.

implementation.title: Cover restore and malformed-input behavior
implementation.description: Extend the StoryBiblePanel test and docs so backup, restore, reset, and invalid payload handling are exercised and documented.

cross_module_dependencies.reason: Story Bible shows character and location data from the same knowledge surface that module D is closing. E1 must keep its copy and docs aligned so graph-backed sections are not mislabeled as locally editable or project-persistent.

risks: If execution stops at panel copy without adding the dedicated test, the local-only contract will drift again as StoryBiblePanel evolves.
Export/import UX can be mistaken for shared or synced persistence unless labels, docs, and payload contents consistently exclude graph-backed entities.
Concurrent changes in the knowledge-surface module can invalidate Story Bible wording if the graph-backed sections are renamed or made interactive without coordination.
out_of_scope: True project-level Story Bible persistence through gateway endpoints, SQLite, or Tauri-managed storage.
Shared/team sync, cloud backup, or multi-device reconciliation for Story Bible state.
Creating or editing character, location, or plot graph entities from inside StoryBiblePanel.
